test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A garrison of 140 men has provisions for 35 days. At the end of 10 days, 35 more men joined them. How many days can they sustain on the remaining provisions?
solution:
**Given:**

A garrison of 140 men has provisions for 35 days. At the end of 10 days, 35 more men joined them.

**Formula used:**

Initial total provisions = Number of men × Number of days

Remaining provisions after 10 days = Initial total provisions - (Number of men × Days consumed)

New number of men = Initial number of men + Additional men

New number of days = Remaining provisions / New number of men
